description: This file implements a command handler for updating loan charges within the Fineract project. It processes commands related to loan charge updates, invoking the appropriate service method to perform the update.

classes.name: UpdateLoanChargeCommandHandler
classes.description: A command handler class that processes 'UPDATE' commands for loan charges, delegating the update operation to the LoanChargeWritePlatformService.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the incoming JSON command to update a loan charge by calling the service layer method with the loan ID, charge ID, and command details.
